class.name: social_nav_costs/SocialLayer
class.description: Stamps anisotropic human personal-space cost into a Nav2 costmap so the planner routes around people. Cost is soft (below lethal).

class.name: social_nav_costs/RestrictedZoneLayer
class.description: Stamps configured axis-aligned restricted rectangles (map frame) into a Nav2 costmap at a high but sub-lethal cost, so the planner routes around industrial keep-out zones and heavy machinery. Default zone list is empty (a no-op layer).
